SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Mag. p.]
Pains at pit of stomach, nipping, griping, pinching, with short belching of wind giving no relief.
Spasms or cramp in stomach, with clean tongue, pain as if a band was tightly laced or drawn around body.
Neuralgia of stomach.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Mag. p.]
Left lobe of liver enlarged.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Mag. p.]
Cramps in abdomen ; pains around navel and above it towards stomach, from there radiating to both sides towards back ; violent cutting pains, so that she has to scream out, then shooting and violently contracting ; > by bending double or by pressure with hand, external warmth and eructations ; cannot lie on back stretched out.
Cramps and wind colic, often accompanied by watery diarrhœa.
Colic : forcing patient to bend double, pain > by friction, warmth, or eructations ; remittent gripes, crampy pain.
Flatulent colic forcing patient to bend double, > from rubbing, warmth, accompanied by belching of gas, which gives no relief.
Flatulent colic of children and the new born, with drawing up of legs ; remittent colic, crampy pain with acidity.
Daily attacks of colic in a child, generally at 3 or 4 P. M., lasting several hours.
Pains spasmodic in stomach or bowels, griping, cutting, drawing, so as to bend body double, < on slightest muscular movement ; > from warmth.
Meteorism, in cows.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Mag. p.]
Stools expelled with force.
Stools loose, watery, with urging. θ Pain in stomach.
Watery diarrhœa, with vomiting and cramps in calves ; choleraic cramps.
(In sick :) Diarrhœa, with pinching colicky pain from navel to back ; stools every half hour ; redness and itching on feet, cannot keep them still, in evening.
Dysentery : with crampy pain, > by bending double, warmth or friction ; with spasmodic retention of urine.
Cholera caused by affection of nerves of intestinal canal.
Cutting, darting, lightning-like pains in hemorrhoids.
Stool torpid. θ Faceache. θ Crampy colic.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Mag. p.]
Every three or five minutes child passes a large quantity of urine ; great appetite, empties six or eight bottles every day, restless sleep at night.
Gravel, windy pain.
Spasm of neck of bladder ; spasmodic stricture.
Nocturnal enuresis from nervous irritation.
Vesical neuralgia after use of catheter, sensation as if muscles did not contract.
A bright, slimy discharge from urethra in an old man ; when urinating, violent shooting and burning pains.
Urine clear like water. θ Colic.
Deficiency or excess of urinary phosphates.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Mag. p.]
Ovarian neuralgia, pain shooting and darting like lightning ; < on right side.
Menstrual colic, pain during or preceding flow ; vaginismus.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Mag. p.]
Spasmodic labor pains ; cramp in legs.
Puerperal convulsions.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Mag. p.]
Laryngismus stridulus or spasm of larynx ; constriction of chest ; stiffness of limbs.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Mag. p.]
Spasmodic sobbing for three days.
Spasmodic, nervous asthma.
   

COUGH. [27] [Mag. p.]
Spasmodic cough : at night, with difficulty in lying down ; in paroxysms ; without expectoration ; ending in a whoop.
Violent spasmodic attacks of cough, recurring about ten times a day, during which face becomes blue and turgid. θ Whooping cough.
Persistent semi-chronic cough of a pseudo-catarrhal, nervous character.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Mag. p.]
Constriction of chest and throat, with spasmodic, dry, tickling cough.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Mag. p.]
Angina pectoris ; neuralgic spasms.
Nervous, spasmodic palpitation.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Mag. p.]
Intercostal neuralgia, of a drawing, constrictive kind ; spasms from cold.
An old lady had terrible pain from back under left scapula around to front and down to groin, constricted chest and affected breathing ; paroxysms brought on by lying down, had to sit upright. θ Intercostal neuralgia.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Mag. p.]
Pains in nape of neck very sharp, shooting, boring, shifting and remittent.
Shifting pains in back ; intercostal neuralgia.
Acute, boring, darting, neuralgic pains in back.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Mag. p.]
Shaking of hands, trembling ; alcoholism.
